title: JAAM (Just Another Ambiance Modpack)
description: A curated mix of action, movement, and animation mods that bring Minecraft to life with fluid gameplay and immersive mechanics.
body:
![The JAAM logo over a beautiful background: a sunset over a cherry tree-topped mountain range](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/463d1127ca638f2becd26ec2be8a8d87ace943ea_0.webp)
# **This modpack is built to make Minecraft feel alive.**

From fluid player movement and detailed animations to immersive combat and responsive environments, **Just Another Ambiance Modpack (JAAM)** transforms the game into a dynamic experience. The goal is simple: remove the stiffness, amplify the energy, and create a world that feels reactive, engaging, and full of motion. It is highly reccomended to read and follow all of the instructions on [JAAM's wiki](https://github.com/sheppcrafd/JAAM/wiki) for details, an Emotecraft tutorial, list of mods, and an installation guide.

# **Version 3.0 is OUT!!!**
**(only on modrinth)**

## **Features:**
- Enhanced movement mechanics for a more agile player experience
- Smooth combat systems with impactful feedback and variety
- Mobs with improved behavior and lifelike animations
- A lightweight, optimized Fabric-based setup for fast load times and performance
- Configs and visuals carefully tuned to support immersion and flow

This is not a cinematic overhaul or a hardcore RPG — it's Minecraft with motion, reaction, and energy. If you want your world to feel like it’s moving with you, this pack is built for exactly that.

**Feel free to comment if there are errors you would like help with fixing or you need help with something like installation or settings. Include JAAM versions, steps to reproduce, and crash logs if needed. I read the recent ones every weekday.**
